instructions: Compare the human review messages with the before and after text for the changed section. Choose resolved in spirit only when the revised text implements what the human asked for. Choose unrelated when the section changed without addressing the request. Agent replies do not establish the request.

labels.name: resolved in spirit
labels.description: The revised text does what the human comment asked, even if the wording or structure changed.

input.before: A spec needs the human when its registry row's spec has changed since the row's base and its review is not Finished. TBD: the registry alone does not say this. Changed since base needs a read-only git diff --quiet <base> -- <spec> in the row's root; not Finished needs a read of the spec's .review/ spool for the processed empty Finish hand-off. Pick: the provider reads both, or spec-chat's registry records them.
input.after: A spec needs the human when its file differs between the registry row's base and the row root's working tree: a read-only git diff --quiet <base> -- <spec> in the row's root. No spool is read. Processing a Finish hand-off advances that row's base to the Finished commit (spec-chat, skill/review-spec/SKILL.md, Remote hosting lifecycle), so a Finished spec stops differing. A row whose git read fails is not highlighted.

No spool is read. Processing a Finish hand-off first commits the exact reviewed spec bytes when the working tree differs from HEAD, and that commit, else HEAD, becomes the row's base (spec-chat, skill/review-spec/SKILL.md, Remote hosting lifecycle), so a Finished spec stops differing.
